test_cases.description: StepPage must render a distinct CodeBlock for each command entry — commands must not be concatenated or merged into a single block
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with 3 distinct command entries each having unique command strings
test_cases.expected_output_description: 3 CodeBlock components rendered, each receiving one command's data
assertions: When given 3 commands, exactly 3 separate CodeBlock instances are rendered, not 1 or 2

test_cases.description: StepPage must render a distinct CodeBlock for each example entry — examples must not be concatenated into fewer blocks
test_cases.expected_output_description: 4 CodeBlock components rendered for examples section
assertions: When given 4 examples, exactly 4 separate CodeBlock instances are rendered for examples

test_cases.description: StepPage must pass through the description field of each CommandEntry to the CodeBlock component, not just the command string
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with commands that have non-trivial description fields
test_cases.expected_output_description: Each CodeBlock receives the description associated with its command
assertions: CodeBlock receives both command and description from CommandEntry

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must not render when youtubeUrl is an empty string — only non-empty strings trigger rendering
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with youtubeUrl set to empty string ''
assertions: YouTubeEmbed component is not present in the rendered tree when youtubeUrl is ''

test_cases.description: VersionBadge must not render when version is an empty string — only non-empty strings trigger rendering
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with version set to empty string ''
assertions: VersionBadge component is not present in the rendered tree when version is ''

test_cases.description: getStepContent should return the same object reference as directly accessing STEP_CONTENT, not a copy or reconstruction
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returned object is referentially identical to the STEP_CONTENT entry
assertions: getStepContent(stepId) === STEP_CONTENT[stepId] for multiple step IDs

test_cases.description: getStepContent must reject various non-StepId inputs including empty string, numeric values, null, and close misspellings
assertions: Throws for misspelled step id like 'cartographr'

test_cases.description: STEP_CONTENT must be deeply frozen — nested objects within entries should also be immutable at runtime
test_cases.input_description: Attempt to push to STEP_CONTENT.cartographer.commands or modify STEP_CONTENT.cartographer.overview
assertions: Attempting to mutate a nested property (e.g., push to commands array, modify overview) either throws or has no effect

test_cases.description: StepPage must render arbitrary content passed via props — it cannot hardcode known STEP_CONTENT values
test_cases.input_description: A completely synthetic StepContent with unique strings not found in any STEP_CONTENT entry
test_cases.expected_output_description: All synthetic strings appear in the rendered output in the correct elements

test_cases.description: Every entry in STEP_CONTENT must have a non-empty overview string — the contract requires this as a precondition for StepPage
assertions: Every entry's overview is a string with length > 0 and is not just whitespace

test_cases.description: When multiple callouts with different variants are provided, each CalloutBox must receive its own specific variant — variants must not be swapped or defaulted
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with callouts in order: gotcha, tip, warning
test_cases.expected_output_description: Three CalloutBox components with variants in the exact same order

test_cases.description: The barrel index must re-export all 14 page components, both enums, STEP_CONTENT constant, and getStepContent function as named exports
Every callout entry across all STEP_CONTENT must use a valid CalloutVariant enum value — no typos or invalid strings
assertions: Every callout.variant in every entry is one of 'gotcha', 'warning', 'tip'

test_cases.description: StepPage must correctly render both YouTubeEmbed and VersionBadge simultaneously when both youtubeUrl and version are non-empty
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with both youtubeUrl and version set to non-empty strings
assertions: Both YouTubeEmbed and VersionBadge are present in the rendered output

test_cases.description: StepPage must handle a single command entry correctly — exactly one CodeBlock, not zero or duplicated
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with exactly one command entry
assertions: Exactly 1 CodeBlock rendered for commands section when commands has length 1

test_cases.description: HomePage must use the content keyed by the 'home' StepId, not any other step — it should display the home label and overview specifically
When commands array is empty, StepPage must not render any section heading for commands — the entire section should be absent, not just the code blocks
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with empty commands array but non-empty callouts and examples
assertions: No 'Commands' or similar section heading exists in rendered output when commands is empty array

test_cases.description: The StepId enum must have exactly 13 members and STEP_CONTENT must have exactly 13 entries — guards against missing or extra entries
Each wrapper page component must render the correct StepLabel in its h1 — not a generic or swapped label from another step
test_cases.input_description: Render StigmergyPage, ApprenticePage, and KindexPage and inspect h1 text

test_cases.description: StepPage must pass through the text field of each callout item to the CalloutBox component — not just the variant
test_cases.input_description: StepContent with callouts having unique, distinguishable text strings
test_cases.expected_output_description: Each callout text appears in the rendered output
assertions: Each CalloutBox receives the correct text string from its corresponding CalloutItem
